description: Image Description: The image features a two-tiered serving tray with various food items. The top tier holds several scones, some of which have raisins, and a small dish of butter. The bottom tier contains an assortment of finger sandwiches with visible fillings like ham and greens. There is also a small sandwich roll with a creamy filling. The scene suggests a setting for afternoon tea, with a focus on pastries and sandwiches. The background includes a reflective surface, possibly a table, which adds an elegant touch
